versions.author: designer
versions.summary:
Climbers in the back row grow with the biggest friendly unit in front of them, of any tribe.
They feed, drain or copy that host, making other tribes' carries stronger.

versions.author: reviser
versions.summary:
Viscum now rises at End of Turn with every gain in full instead of his half rise, Young Ivy's count never resets, and Woodbine pays only for a host it's never given to.
Rise gets a +1/+1 floor and Traveller's Joy's wording is cleaned up, so early climbers visibly grow and every card reads clearly.

stop_reason: 2 of 3 reviewers said it's in a good spot
